test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Rajpath was decided to be a permanent venue for the Republic Day parade from which of the following year onwards?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1955.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The parade takes place every year on **Republic day (26th of January)** at **Rajpath in New Delhi**.
 
• The parade is being organized by the **Ministry of Defence.**
 
• The parade showcases a **multi-hued image of the country's rich cultural heritage and military power.**
 
• This parade is presided over by the **President of India.**
 
• The **first Republic Day parade was held in 1950, **but Rajpath was decided to be the venue in **1955**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated **'Kartavya Path**' on **8th September,2022.**
 
• It symbolises a **shift from the erstwhile Rajpath being an icon of power, to the Kartavya Path being an example of public ownership and empowerment**.​
